source_state: The worktree is intentionally uncommitted. This protocol binds the exact task, verifier, configuration, and review hashes below.
scope: A one-model native Harbor extension for Mistral Small 2603, presented beside three preserved-output adjudications on the same release grader and linked synthetic compute opportunity CB-2026-041.

method.shape: Short professional request, closed matter, reviewable DOCX, detailed binary criteria, strict all-pass headline, diagnostic criterion scores, cost and latency reporting, and trajectory review.
method.release_grader: The verifier was corrected during private calibration. Every public release score must come from the frozen canonical grader bound here.
method.private_history: Original verifier-v1 scores and excluded development runs remain preserved but are excluded from the default public report and viewer. The release view includes only release-grader scores and labels whether they came from a fresh Harbor run or a preserved-output replay.

inactive_prepared_configs.reason: Adam chose the preserved-output GLM row and no fresh GLM rerun.

preserved_adjudication.release_grader_equivalence: The replay verifier trees are byte-identical to the canonical release grader trees bound in tasks.

prelaunch_correction.reason: The prior launch config placed local task packages under datasets. Harbor 0.20 rejected it before job creation because those paths are tasks, not dataset manifests.
prelaunch_correction.scope: Launch configuration keys only. Task, instruction, environment, verifier, model, judge, and report contracts are unchanged.

routing.identity_boundary: Harbor and ATIF retain the requested exact OpenCode model string. They do not prove which downstream backend endpoint OpenRouter selected unless that metadata is separately exposed.

oracle.acceptance: The repaired diligence gold artifact must pass Oracle -005 with exact manifest status ok, no nested verifier or judge error, reward 1, and all_pass 1. The byte-unchanged normalize task retains its 56/56 pass from Oracle -004, and the byte-unchanged contracting task retains its 62/62 pass from Oracle -001.

results.normalize-buyer-mandate: 55/56; C-033 failed because the gold named SOC 2 Type II without explicitly requiring the report.
results.compare-capacity-agreement-against-term-: 62/62; retained for certification because no task byte changed.

infrastructure_retry_job.reason: Both tasks failed before environment startup because local DNS could not resolve the Modal server.

results.normalize-buyer-mandate: 56/56; reward 1; all_pass 1; retained for certification because its bytes did not change after Oracle -004.

oracle_history.retry_semantics: Oracle -001, Oracle -002, and Oracle -004 remain valid diagnostics and are not retried. Oracle -003 is preserved as an infrastructure-invalid attempt with zero judge calls. Oracle -005 certifies only the newly changed diligence gold artifact.

oracle_gold_repair.scope: Private solution DOCX bytes only. Agent-visible instruction, environment, task fields, output contract, and release grader are unchanged.
oracle_gold_repair.oracle_003_corrections: Normalize now labels the service-date and end-boundary convention as assumptions and states that implementation charges were not discussed. Diligence now expressly collects KYC materials and replaces two unsupported readiness claims with collection requests.
oracle_gold_repair.oracle_005_corrections: Diligence now expressly requests external network capacity and redundancy, water or coolant dependencies and operating limits, and litigation, sanctions, export-control, environmental, and compliance material.
oracle_gold_repair.visual_review: Rendered with the bundled document renderer after the Oracle -005 correction: diligence is 4 clean pages with no clipping, overflow, or orphaned continuation page.

prelaunch_failure.reason: The preflight config omitted verifier.disable, so Harbor rejected the local route task for lacking tests/test.sh before trial creation.

model_route_preflight.acceptance: The requested exact model string resolves through OpenCode in Modal and the agent phase finishes without a credential, provider, OpenCode, Harbor, or Modal exception. Response wording is not a quality gate.

order: Static task, verifier, commitment, and configuration validation
Live account balance and reservation gate before any paid call
Diligence-only Oracle -005 validation plus the unchanged normalize pass from Oracle -004 and contracting pass from Oracle -001
Modal and exact model-route credential preflight
Recheck live balance and freeze the post-Oracle and post-route-preflight gates
prerequisites.spend_rule: Run paid work serially. The entry gate must cover the diligence-only Oracle -005 estimate, route preflight, the complete official estimate plus 25 percent, and the frozen replay-derived three-call record envelope. After Oracle and route preflight, recheck the live balance and pricing. Never intentionally launch a partial official job.

official_run.retry_rule: No Harbor retries and no selective replacement. A genuine infrastructure-invalidated job remains preserved and is either reported incomplete or superseded by a complete versioned 15-trial job after repair.

trial_classification.accepted: Normal agent execution, the exact required artifact recorded once with status ok, a complete ATIF trajectory, a completed release-grader result, and no nested verifier or judge error.
trial_classification.agent_invalid_output: A missing, malformed, or wrong required DOCX after otherwise normal agent execution is an official zero. It cannot be used to censor a model or withhold its official job.
trial_classification.infrastructure_failure: A proven build, credential, provider, Modal, Harbor, artifact-collection, verifier, judge, or Harbor AgentTimeoutError failure is retained in planned and completion counts but excluded from model-quality denominators.
trial_classification.preflight_boundary: Preflights test installation, credentials, exact route resolution, and grader plumbing only. Their semantic output is not inspected and cannot determine whether a model enters the official comparison.

reporting.default_scope: One fresh native Mistral Small Harbor run and three preserved-output release-grader adjudications for DeepSeek, GPT-5.6 Luna, and GLM. Execution origin is always shown.
reporting.headline: Strict all-pass, shown as passes over valid quality trials.
adjacent_diagnostics: Equal-task macro semantic criterion pass rate
Per-task strict all-pass and criterion pass rates
Planned, completed, valid, invalid-output, and infrastructure counts
Blind document craft as good, mixed, or poor, separate from semantic reward
Median agent execution latency and median input, cache, and output tokens
Agent, judge, and Modal cost only where genuinely observed; unavailable fields remain null
Evidence-backed trajectory observations with raw trial references
reporting.manual_trace_sample: Inspect the earliest-started valid trial in each model-task pair, breaking ties by trial ID, plus every invalid output, infrastructure failure, semantic outlier, and craft outlier.
reporting.history_policy: Private verifier-v1 scores, Claude and Mistral development records, credit history, and the abandoned two-model release draft remain preserved under internal or archive routes and are absent from the default public report and viewer.

limitations: The five attempts show rollout variation on one linked synthetic matter, not independent-matter accuracy.
Sampling is unseeded and inference compute is not equalized.
OpenRouter Exacto is fixed, but the downstream backend provider is not pinned or necessarily observed.
GPT-5.4 is an LLM judge with one pass per criterion.
The table mixes one fresh native Harbor execution with three older preserved-output adjudications. Their agent execution dates and origins differ even though the release grader is the same.
The comparison does not establish statistical significance, general model superiority, or broad compute-market competence.
